''See also: [[Emriss Silentborn Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Emriss Silentborn, also known as [[the Forest]] [[Monarch]] or the [[Remnant]] [[Monarch]], is [[the Queen]] of the Everwood continent{{!}}Everwood Continent and ruler of [[Titan]]'s Grove. Originally a [[men’hla tree]], she attained sentience through extraordinary circumstances and ascended to become a [[Monarch]]. In her human form, she appears as a dark-skinned woman with bark-like skin and hair composed of braided blue-green vines, typically carrying a staff topped with a diamond flower. She possesses connections to the Life and Oracle [[Icons]]. Emriss is known for her soothing, motherly, and reassuring presence, which contrasts with the overwhelming Spiritual pressure{{!}}spiritual pressure typically exuded by other [[Monarchs]]. She is a highly public figure who travels extensively to spread peace, education, and language to humanity. One of her significant achievements is the creation of the [[Dreamway]], an interconnected [[library]] of [[dream tablets]] designed to inspire artists and preserve knowledge. Throughout history, she has maintained a complex relationship with the [[Dreadgod]] known as the [[Silent King]]. While she has worked to keep him at bay, it has been revealed that she sometimes allowed certain events to unfold according to her own long-term designs. In times of crisis, such as the awakening of the [[Wandering Titan]] or the release of the [[Silent King]], she has acted as a leader, calling for assistance and providing medicinal [[elixirs]] to aid those injured by the conflicts of the era.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Originally a massive blue-green [[men'hla tree]] with bark-like skin and luminous vine hair, Emriss can transform into a dark-haired woman. In her various forms, she has been described as having purple and green eyes and skin with bark-like patterns. She often carries a staff made of living wood topped with a glowing diamond crystal.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the most public [[Monarch]], Emriss is a selfless leader dedicated to spreading peace, education, and the gift of language. She is known for her ability to cooperate with others, restore spirits, and provide guidance to those she protects. Despite a gentle voice, she can also be mocking.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Emriss utilizes [[Forged madra]] to weave Life aura{{!}}life aura, accelerate healing, and cleanse injuries. She can observe entire battlefields and multiple possible futures at once, and she even created the [[Dreamway]] to enter people's [[dreams]] for teaching. Her techniques include the use of gentle leaves and a connection to the Life and Oracle [[Icons]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Binding the Silent King}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Emriss Silentborn is a [[Monarch]] who rules the [[Everwood continent]] and addressed her citizens after the sky turned black.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c2">''Dreadgod'', chapter 2</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3">''Dreadgod'', chapter 3</ref> During this time, she warned her people to deny any strangers attempting to enter their minds through [[dreams]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /> Possessing complete knowledge regarding the [[Chief Guardians]], she called for help and used her power and preparations to prevent [[Everwood]] from bowing to the [[Silent King]].<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c3" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c4">''Dreadgod'', chapter 4</ref> Having successfully sealed the [[Silent King]] off, she is a woman with a gentle but mocking voice who can observe an entire battlefield and multiple possible futures simultaneously.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c15">''Dreadgod'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18">''Dreadgod'', chapter 18</ref> When the [[Dreadgod]] sought to kill her, Emriss whispered into its mind and intended to keep others away from [[Lindon]] while he weakened the creature.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c18" /><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19">''Dreadgod'', chapter 19</ref> As the oldest [[Monarch]], she protected [[Lindon]] by taking a human form as a dark-haired woman carrying a staff topped with a flashing blue-green diamond.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c19" /> This transforming tree-woman is known for her selfless contributions to the global order.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21">''Dreadgod'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22">''Dreadgod'', chapter 22</ref> She created the [[Dreamway]] to teach others by slipping into their [[dreams]], a process through which she sends messages at great expense.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c22" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Herald and Guide}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Emriss Silentborn is a [[Herald]] who Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara believes can be reasoned with, despite the fact that Emriss has been lying to Luminous Queen Sha Miara{{!}}Sha Miara's family for generations.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30">''Waybound'', chapter 30</ref> Appearing on a half-ruined hillside, Emriss uses [[Forged madra]] to accelerate healing by weaving Life aura{{!}}life aura.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /> After attempting to trap Reigan Shen{{!}}Reigan, Emriss joined the fight using techniques such as gentle leaves.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" /> Emriss placed a hand on [[Yerin]]'s shoulder and then led the group through the gateway using a diamond-headed staff.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31">''Waybound'', chapter 31</ref> With leaves in her hair, Emriss Silentborn eventually left plans for [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c31" /><ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c33">''Waybound'', chapter 33</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Forest Monarch}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Emriss Silentborn serves as [[the Forest]] [[Monarch]], a leader who gathered supplies remaining after the [[Dread War]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 1</ref> Possessing the ability to cleanse injuries, Emriss has dark skin marked by patterns that resemble tree bark.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" /> This monarch features purple and green eyes and carries a staff made of living wood topped with a softly glowing crystal.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c1" />}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“Emriss could have—” The Sword Sage visibly realized he’d been about to compare Lindon to a Monarch and forced a cough.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“We were decimated by Emriss Silentborn, and you did nothing!<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“It was him and Reigan Shen together,” Emriss said sadly.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c24" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Emriss Silentborn’s voice blew over to them like leaves on a gentle wind. “You should expect a fight.”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c29" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“We can reason with Emriss! She’ll listen!”<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c30" />}}
